headline: The second cup cools faster.
body: Someone has propped the stair door with a catalogue. Light reaches the filing cabinet and stops. Outside, a bicycle ticks past without ringing.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: thin blue under a milky lid, no contrail

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: on the cabinet edge, nowhere else

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: bicycle tick, no bell, one shutter newly up
